tools.name: base_balance
tools.description: Base wallet balances: native ETH and USDC for any address, with the block number they were read at. Price: $0.003 USDC on Base per call (x402).

tools.name: base_tx
tools.description: Decode a Base transaction: status, block time, from/to, ETH value, fee, method selector and every ERC-20 transfer with symbol and human amount. Flags fake look-alike tokens (address-poisoning, e.g. a fake USDC with homoglyph characters). Price: $0.003 USDC on Base per call (x402).

tools.name: domain_email_check
tools.description: Domain DNS and email-security check: A/AAAA, NS, MX (incl. null MX), SPF, DMARC policy, CAA, plus a list of issues and a 0-100 email security score. Use before sending email to or trusting a domain. Price: $0.003 USDC on Base per call (x402).

tools.name: evm_decode_calldata
tools.description: Decode EVM transaction calldata before signing: finds the function signature (signature DB, verified by re-encoding to reject selector collisions), decodes all arguments, expands multicall batches, and warns about unlimited token approvals, approve-all-NFTs, permits, ownership changes and upgrades.

tools.name: evm_typed_data_check

tools.name: base_gas
tools.description: Base gas snapshot: gas price, base fee, priority fee, 10-block base-fee trend, ETH/USD (Chainlink) and estimated USD cost of an ETH transfer, ERC-20 transfer, swap and contract deploy right now. Price: $0.003 USDC on Base per call (x402).

tools.name: ens_resolve
tools.description: Resolve ENS and Basenames (name.eth, name.base.eth): name → address, or address → primary name with forward verification, plus text records (avatar, description, url, twitter, github, email). Price: $0.003 USDC on Base per call (x402).

tools.name: domain_dns
tools.description: DNS lookup in one call: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS and CAA records with TTLs (or just the types you ask for), NXDOMAIN status, DNSSEC validation, plus parsed hints: SPF record, CAA certificate issuers and which services the domain is verified with (TXT verification tokens). Resolved via DNS-over-HT

tools.name: domain_dns_batch
tools.description: DNS lookup for up to 12 domains in ONE paid call: A, AAAA, MX and NS by default (or the types you ask for), NXDOMAIN status, DNSSEC validation and SPF/verification hints per name, plus a summary of which names resolve, which are NXDOMAIN and which have MX. Resolved via DNS-over-HTTPS. names x types

tools.name: domain_ssl

Flags certs expiring within 14/30 days, missi

tools.name: domain_overview
tools.description: One-call domain overview: registration (RDAP age, expiry, registrar, DNSSEC), DNS (A/AAAA/NS/MX/CAA), email security (SPF, DMARC policy, 0-100 score, issues) and HTTPS/TLS (reachable, HSTS, cert issuer and days left), with merged flags, an 'attention' list and a verdict: ok, check (risk flags found)

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: domain_email_check, domain_overview, x402_preflight, web_link_check, web_extract · Private data: base_token_check, base_token_price, base_balance, base_tx, evm_decode_calldata, evm_typed_data_check, ens_resolve, domain_dns, base_portfolio, wallet_screen, web_link_check · Public sink: domain_email_check, ens_resolve, domain_whois, domain_overview, wallet_screen · Destructive: web_security_headers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: domain_email_check, domain_overview, x402_preflight, web_link_check, web_extract · Private data: base_token_check, base_token_price, base_balance, base_tx, evm_decode_calldata, evm_typed_data_check, ens_resolve, domain_dns, base_portfolio, wallet_screen, web_link_check · Public sink: domain_email_check, ens_resolve, domain_whois, domain_overview, wallet_screen · Destructive: web_security_headers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
